method: 逐項對照固定同頁完整說明、簡短說明與備註；來源清楚指出的歧義採取語境校訂，不聲稱遊戲內核驗。

cases.decision: 範圍內非精靈生物各自攻擊命中時獲得體力；不是僅施放者。

sources.title: Predatory Season
sources.description: [[Nature Ritual]]. Create a level {{gr|1|10}} [[spirit]]. For non-spirit [[creature]]s within its [[Spirit range|range]], all [[heal]]ing is reduced by 20%. If any of your [[attack]]s hit, you [[Health gain|gain]] 5 [[Health]]. This spirit dies after {{gr|30|240}} seconds.
sources.conciseDescription: Nature Ritual. Creates a level {{gr|1|10}} spirit ({{gr|30|240}} second lifespan). Creatures in range receive 20% less from healing. Creatures gain 5 health each time they hit with an attack. Does not affect spirits.

cases.decision: 百分比縮短病症持續時間，不是提高消退速度；兩模式創造同名精靈。

sources.title: Recovery
sources.description: [[Binding Ritual]]. Create a level {{gr|1|14}} [[spirit]]. [[Condition]]s on [[ally|allies]] within [[Spirit range|range]] of this spirit expire {{gr|20|50||%}} faster. This spirit dies after {{gr|30|60}} seconds.
sources.conciseDescription: Binding Ritual. Creates a level {{gr|1|14}} spirit ({{gr|30|60}} second lifespan). Conditions on allies in range expire {{gr|20|50||%}} faster.

warnings.text: The French translation of [[Spirit of Recovery]] is the same as [[Spirit of Recuperation]] but with a lower case "r", which can be misleading.
Rather than conditions expiring at a faster rate, their duration is reduced by the stated percentage.

sources.conciseDescription: Binding Ritual. Creates a level {{gr|1|10}} spirit ({{gr|30|60}} second lifespan). Conditions on allies in range expire {{gr|20|50||%}} faster.

cases.decision: 範圍內非精靈生物造成物理傷害時附加四點；受傷者可包含精靈。

sources.title: Winnowing
sources.description: [[Nature Ritual]]. Create a level {{gr|1|10}} [[spirit]].  Non-spirit [[creature]]s within [[Spirit range|range]] take 4 additional [[damage]] whenever they take [[physical damage]].  This spirit dies after {{gr|30|240}} seconds.
sources.conciseDescription: Nature Ritual. Creates a level {{gr|1|10}} spirit ({{gr|30|240}} second lifespan). Increases physical damage by +4 for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

warnings.text: Contrary to the full description, creatures in range deal +4 damage, not receive. This means that all creatures, including spirits, do take +4 damage.

cases.decision: 單次傷害上限包含魔法與紋章；依兩模式各自 anomaly 澄清。

sources.title: Shelter
sources.description: [[Binding Ritual]]. Create a level {{gr|1|12}} [[spirit]]. Non-spirit [[Ally|allies]] within its [[Spirit range|range]] cannot lose more than 10% maximum [[Health]] from a single [[attack]]. When this spirit prevents [[damage]], it loses {{gr|75|45}} Health. This spirit lasts {{gr|30|60}} seconds.
sources.conciseDescription: Binding Ritual. Creates a level {{gr|1|12}} spirit ({{gr|30|60}} second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. {{gray|Damage prevention cost: this spirit loses {{gr|75|45}} Health.}}

warnings.text: [[Armor of Unfeeling]] will reduce the health loss of this spirit caused by its damage mitigation effect.
While skill descriptions state "attacks", [[damage]] from [[spell]]s and [[signet]]s is also reduced.
Shelter's effect persists briefly after it prevents damage in a way that would have killed it ([https://youtu.be/7AFx0dp8_-o video]).

This spirit lasts {{gr|30|60}} seconds.
sources.conciseDescription: Binding Ritual. Creates a level {{gr|1|8}} spirit ({{gr|30|60}} second lifespan). Non-spirit allies within range cannot lose more than 10% maximum Health from a single attack. {{gray|Damage prevention cost: this spirit loses {{gr|75|45}} Health.}}

warnings.text: While skill descriptions state "attacks", [[damage]] from [[spell]]s and [[signet]]s is also reduced.

cases.decision: 轉換範圍內攻擊者造成的物理傷害，受傷者所在位置不是觸發條件。

sources.title: Greater Conflagration
sources.description: [[Elite]] [[Nature Ritual]]. Create a level {{gr|1|10}} [[spirit]]. For non-spirit [[creature]]s within its [[Spirit range|range]], all [[physical damage]] is [[fire damage]] instead. This spirit dies after {{gr|30|240}} seconds.
sources.conciseDescription: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level {{gr|1|10}} spirit ({{gr|30|240}} second lifespan). Converts physical damage to fire damage for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

warnings.text: Unlike [[Winter]] this skill requires the ''attacker'' to be inside the spirit [[area of effect]].

Does not properly convert the physical damage of certain skills (notably: [[Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support]] and [[Veil of Thorns]]). As a result, the skill chain will not trigger the conditional effects of other skills that depend on fire damage (in particular, for [[Intensity]]).

cases.decision: 轉換最終承受的元素傷害；攻擊者或受傷者任一在範圍內即可。
cases.unresolved: 完整說明沒有排除精靈，簡短說明卻排除精靈；顯示待核實。

sources.title: Winter
sources.description: [[Nature Ritual]]. Create a level {{gr|1|10}} [[spirit]]. For [[creature]]s within its [[Spirit range|range]], all [[elemental damage]] is [[cold damage]] instead. This spirit dies after {{gr|30|240}} seconds.
sources.conciseDescription: Nature Ritual. Creates a level {{gr|1|10}} spirit ({{gr|30|240}} second lifespan). Converts elemental damage to cold damage for creatures in range. Does not affect spirits.

warnings.text: Unlike [[Greater Conflagration]] or [[Conflagration]] this skill requires ''either'' the attacker or the damage receiver to be inside the spirit [[area of effect]].

cases.decision: 正式說明保留 +24 與額外 +24；獨立錯誤備註說明實際疊加上限 +25 及 35.2% 減傷。

sources.title: Great Dwarf Armor
sources.description: [[Enchantment Spell]]. For {{gr2|22|40}} seconds, [[target]] [[ally]] has +24 [[Armor rating|armor]], +60 maximum [[Health]], and an additional +24 armor against [[Destroyer]]s.
sources.conciseDescription: Enchantment Spell.  ({{gr2|22|40}} seconds.)  +24 armor and +60 maximum Health.  Additional +24 armor against Destroyers.

warnings.text: The armor bonus while fighting Destroyers is calculated as two sources, the initial +24 armor and then the +24 armor against Destroyers. The armor bonus is therefore capped at +25 armor due to [[effect stacking]] (giving a 35.2% [[damage reduction]] bonus).

cases.decision: 每次受到傷害的減免逐次累加為五、十、十五等。

sources.title: Shield of Absorption
sources.description: [[Enchantment Spell]]. For {{gr|3|7}} seconds, [[damage]] received by [[target]] [[ally]] is [[Damage reduction|reduced]] by 5 each time that ally is hit while under the effects of this enchantment.
sources.conciseDescription: Enchantment Spell. ({{gr|3|7}} seconds.) Reduces incoming damage by 5 each time target ally takes damage.
